verdict.rationale: Warp's own docs name official SDKs: a TypeScript SDK (warp-hr) and a Go SDK (TeamWarp/warp-go-sdk). The docs say these handle authentication, pagination, retries, error handling and webhook verification, with idiomatic, fully typed code for Node.js, the browser or any fetch-capable runtime. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDKs work as documented, SDKs beyond TypeScript and Go (e.g. Python), and detailed per-SDK reference documentation in the evidence.
